decisions.quote: Given that three of the four studies were supported for the core main dependent variable, based on our pre-registered criteria we concluded our attempt as a (mostly) successful replication.
decisions.location: 3.2 Replication evaluation; independent parent primary reading, with literal supporting contexts in evidence_followup/integration/terminal_field_source_context_0016.result.json
decisions.reason: The Fox/Rottenstreich current authors explicitly preregister a WHOLE-TARGET interpretation criterion and conclude their attempt as a (mostly) successful replication in both Results and Discussion. The codebook gives that author overall verdict precedence over individual successful/unsuccessful studies; the parent is not imposing a 3of4success threshold. The following phrase mostly-successful-yet-mixed describes the component results, with the failures openly retained, but does not revoke the stated overall criterion/outcome. Weaker effect sizes alone also do not make mixed. This hierarchy is documented rather than hiding the qualified wording or selecting only one comparison.
